1879053062.Skill_Desc: Increases the damage you and your companions deal to the foe.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with other potent Incoming Damage effects.</rgb>

1879064070.Skill_Desc: Gain a protective morale shield defending you against incoming damage.\n\nBubble strength is 35% of the targets' Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879064198.Skill_Desc: A song that makes an ally's heart glad again, removing some of the evil that currently plagues it.

1879099270.Skill_Desc: You can instruct someone how to play the bagpipes.

1879113094.Skill_Desc: Roll the dice with an attack that applies a damaging Red gamble to the target.

1879132038.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Ost Guruth in the Lone-lands.

1879172998.Skill_Desc: Removes tier 4 dread obtained from defeat.

1879190662.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter when Kindred with the Malledhrim.

1879198342.Skill_Desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879202182.Skill_Desc: A smashing attack with the shield that can stun an enemy.

1879214342.Skill_Desc:
This allows a Warden to store a gambit for later, letting them use it without having to build it.

<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill requires the Potency effect.
Potency is triggered by the improved versions of Defensive Strike, Deft Strike and Goad. Once potent, the next Gambit used will replace Battle Memory.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Potency is consumed and replaced by a potent version of your next successfully executed Gambit.</rgb>

   <rgb=#00FF00>Cost: % of Max Morale Equal to the Number of Icons used to build Gambit</rgb>

1879218438.Skill_Desc:
Removes one Poison, Fear, Disease, or Wound from nearby fellows.
Protects against further Fears.

Removes additional Fear effects in a small area around your target.

1879222022.Skill_Desc: Summons a spirit companion.\n\nThe Spirit of Nature can greatly aid in restoring the Morale of your fellows.

1879231366.Skill_Desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.

1879239558.Skill_Desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several projectiles toward your target.

1879260038.Skill_Desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nHas a chance to generate additional Focus.

1879262982.Skill_Desc: You strike, not necessarily to deal damage, but to goad your foe into attacking you. You will be ready for their next attack and your strategy helps you and your allies reduce incoming damage.

1879263622.Skill_Desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879276550.Skill_Desc: Your enemies quake, their morale shattered from your pronouncement.

1879291398.Skill_Desc: A melee attack that increases the effects of healing on yourself.\n\nRestores your Morale.

1879319174.Skill_Desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nGenerates threat.

1879342470.Skill_Desc: A steed from the 10-year Anniversary Festival.

1879358086.Skill_Desc: The justice of the Elves is often delivered at the tip of an arrow.

1879387910.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Hultvís.

1879414278.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Yule Festival.

1879457542.Skill_Desc:
A series of precision strikes hit your opponent with a red-hot weapon where already wounded.

This skill will consume any Power Attack, Mighty Blow, or Unerring Strike damage over time effects on your target, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879458182.Skill_Desc: Summons a ferocious battle-kitten to accompany you on your journeys.
1879458182.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from The Renewal of Gondor Rewards Quartermaster in Pelargir (King's Gondor).

1879458694.Skill_Desc: Strike your foe with a powerful melee attack, which you follow up by assuming a defensive posture.

1879466246.Skill_Desc:
Refresh your Steady buff and prepare for combat.
This skill can only be used while in Steady Balance.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Thrust deals more damage.
 Blade Shield gives more Parry chance.</rgb>

1879479302.Skill_Desc: Summons a wintry sheep to accompany you on your travels.
1879479302.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter in the Yule Festival.

1879495302.Skill_Desc: A Memory of Fellowship can be used to inspire your allies, reminding them of their bonds and helping them to resist evil.

1879515014.Skill_Desc: As you reminisce upon your time lost in the deepest shadows, a fragment of darkness breaks away from your own shadow to trouble you for a short while.\n\nNo doubt this is just some trick of the eyes, an illusion sown by your own lingering doubts and fears.
1879515014.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Having walked in places of darkest shadow, you've found that fragments of it still haunt you on occasion.

1879523206.Skill_Desc: Summon an effigy of The Grim Southron, doomed to die shortly after it appears.
1879523206.Skill_Name: The Effigy of The Grim Southron
1879523206.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Summon an effigy of The Grim Southron, doomed to die shortly after it appears.\n\nAvailable from barter on the legendary servers Mordor and Angmar.
